title: Incident response playbook
text: Active compromise, ransomware, malicious administrator or data exfiltration: escalate to Incident Response, preserve evidence and follow the approved incident procedure. No automatic remediation.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: Identity and SSO diagnosis
text: For sign-in failures, SSO loops, directory synchronisation or locked accounts, record scope and timestamps. Identity engineers verify provider status before changing permissions.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: Endpoint reporting and outdated agents
text: Check last heartbeat, deployed version and policy status for the affected laptops. An outdated label alone does not prove protection is disabled. Whole-fleet failure requires urgent investigation.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: Reports and PDF export
text: For empty scheduled reports, inspect schedule and time zone, compare manual export and preserve the error. Use the manual export workaround if it works.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: SIEM and webhook replay
text: Inspect delivery error codes and retry backlog. Compare source counts with received events. Check whether replay can recover missing events before changing connector configuration.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: Detection rules and false positives
text: Record signature version, test file and scope. A false positive blocking all business operations is different from a lab-only test. Only an engineer approves exclusions.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: Awareness campaign failures
text: Record campaign size and failure response. The phishing simulation module is separate from live protection. Check whether campaigns fail at a repeatable audience size.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: Compliance documentation
text: The synthetic compliance portal contains certificate and audit-document downloads. A certificate request is a documentation task, not proof of a security incident.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: VPN and network investigation
text: Record affected sites, devices and working fallback connectivity. Network engineers compare transport errors before making changes.
review_status: SIMULATED sign-off fixture, not a real engineer approval

title: Console performance and monitoring
text: Record affected pages, duration, tenant scope and whether alert delivery still works. Do not infer absence of compromise from a slow dashboard alone.

title: Account and user administration
text: Use the documented user and role-management screen for routine requests. Privileged access changes require identity verification by an engineer.
